handlingDays.title: Handling days
handlingDays.description: Working days from an order to its dispatch: one number (always that many) or two (the fewest and the most), one per line, for example 0 and 1. With the days of your business country's first delivery rate and your business.json country, search engines show your shipping.

pickupEnabled.title: Pickup point
pickupEnabled.description: Without Multi-location stock: the one place where a zone's pickup rates are picked up (with it, the stock locations that take pickups are used).

deliveryNote.title: Delivery time text
deliveryNote.description: Shown with delivery in the cart and on orders, for example "Orders ship on weekdays". Each rate shows its own days.

prepNote.title: Preparation text
prepNote.description: Shown in the cart and on orders, for example "Orders are packed within 24 hours".

pickupReadyNote.title: Pickup ready text
pickupReadyNote.description: Shown on orders for pickup, for example "We message you when it is ready".
